name: Irokuzu Rui
source:
[Passenger]
A woman who, for reasons unknown—perhaps in a fit of madness—chose the *Albatross* as the vessel on which to travel.

She is an acquaintance of the protagonist. With her refined gestures and graceful movements, she carries an air of aristocratic, languid ease; though she clearly belongs to a different class—or perhaps even a different species—than the crew, the protagonist finds her absolutely terrifying.

This is because she is the sort of beauty who brings men to ruin.
In fact, upon their first meeting, the protagonist was dragged into a sordid romantic entanglement he knew nothing about, and nearly stabbed to death by a man he had never even met. And that’s not all—there is something else about her. There has to be.

She, too, must surely possess some bizarre quirk, a strange affliction, or an abnormal constitution—yet the nature of it remains a mystery.

Even the crew hasn’t noticed. It’s terrifying—not knowing is what’s so terrifying. Incidentally, her hobbies are sex and card games.
